name: Mali
headline: Mali: +4.9% growth in 2025, 2.3% inflation, debt 40% of GDP
sections: Mali is a $31.2 billion economy (2025), the world's 117th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +4.9% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $3,503 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 7.5% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 2.3% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 9.7% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 2.8% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 3.9% (2025).
Gross government debt is 40% of GDP (2025), a moderate level. The general government balance is −1.5% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is +0.1% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 49% of GDP (2025), a relatively closed economy. Net FDI inflows were 2.8% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 40% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 60.7 years (2024). Population: 25.2 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
